description: React component for managing OAuth clients in an admin settings page, including listing, creating, approving, and rejecting OAuth clients.

methods.name: OAuthClientsAdminView
methods.description: Main React component for OAuth clients admin view, handling listing, creation, approval, and rejection of OAuth clients.

methods.name: handleCreateClient
methods.description: Handles creation of a new OAuth client with provided form values.

methods.name: handleCloseDialog
methods.description: Closes the OAuth client creation preview dialog.

methods.name: handleCloseClientDialog
methods.description: Closes the OAuth client details dialog.

methods.name: handleApprove
methods.description: Approves a pending OAuth client by clientId.

methods.name: handleReject
methods.description: Rejects an OAuth client with a rejection reason.
